reason: S1 adds the public entry point spng_decode_chunks(), but H0 never calls it. Although H0 can reach read_chunks() indirectly through spng_decoded_image_size() and spng_decode_image(), it cannot exercise the new API's own state-dependent protocol, including its ctx == NULL, ctx->encode_only, pre-SPNG_STATE_INPUT, and SPNG_STATE_IEND branches. This gap did not exist in S0 because spng_decode_chunks() had no declaration or implementation there.
evidence: spng/spng.h newly declares SPNG_API int spng_decode_chunks(spng_ctx *ctx).
spng_decode_chunks() returns distinct results based on ctx == NULL, ctx->encode_only, ctx->state < SPNG_STATE_INPUT, and ctx->state == SPNG_STATE_IEND before calling read_chunks(ctx, 0).
tests/spng_read_fuzzer.c calls spng_decoded_image_size(), spng_decode_image(), spng_get_row_info(), and spng_decode_row(), but contains no call to spng_decode_chunks().
The S0 selected declaration context explicitly reports no matching declaration in the selected production files.
recommended_action: Extend H0 or add a focused target that directly calls spng_decode_chunks() with null, encode-only, no-source, configured-input, and post-IEND contexts, using fuzz data through spng_set_png_buffer(), spng_set_png_stream(), or spng_set_png_file().
